name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2507: Scoping A7 needs a count of who writes each reel store. A filename-adjacency grep returned zero writers for all four stores and so did an AST walk resolving path constants, because paths are bound in helpers and threaded through arguments. Two zeros measuring my instruments, so A7 is not scoped on a number I do not trust. What shipped is the technique the codebase already uses in prose, made checkable - one declared owner per store, every other module a declared reader with a reason, and a new toucher fails until argued in. It reports coupling not writes and says so. The registry caught itself on its first run.
